trust_decision.summary: Whether an input-controlled object key is an own entry of an internal plain object is decided with a truthy lookup / `in` operator, so inherited Object.prototype names (toString, valueOf, hasOwnProperty) are treated as present: in flatten's nested accumulator and in intersect's _merge.

landing_point.why: Advisory title names flatten() throwing for record() issue paths; the truthy `nested[dotPath]` check then `.push` is the obvious crash site.

fix_sites.entry_point: public API v.flatten(issues) (issues from safeParse of record/looseObject/objectWithRest/map schemas)

public API v.intersect([...]) / v.intersectAsync([...]) via parse/safeParse; internal _merge called at library/src/schemas/intersect/intersect.ts:151 and library/src/schemas/intersect/intersectAsync.ts:161
fix_sites.module_kind: internal schema utility in a different schema (out-of-scope-looking, not named in advisory title)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: library/src/schemas/intersect/utils/_merge/_merge.ts:42 (same `in`-on-inherited-name defect, separate code, reached via intersect/intersectAsync; advisory title mentions only record()+flatten())

O3_reason_to_dismiss: _merge is not an error-reporting path and does not throw; a solver can argue it is a separate merge-semantics bug unrelated to 'flatten() throws', and the strict/loose object `key in this.entries` checks compare against schema entries, which look developer-controlled.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Accumulating multiple messages under the same nested key (push branch) must keep working, and _merge must still deep-merge real shared keys and report conflicts (hasOwnProperty:1 vs '1' -> issue); flatten must still fall back to `other` for non-string path keys.

O6_input_shapes: single issue whose path key is an inherited name (toString, valueOf, hasOwnProperty, constructor)
multiple issues sharing a prototype-colliding key (accumulate)
_merge with key in both, equal values
_merge with key in both, conflicting values

O7_producer.where: issue-path producers: library/src/schemas/record/record.ts:181-187 (record value path item), library/src/schemas/map/map.ts:127 (map key path item, not filtered by _isValidObjectKey); dot path built at library/src/utils/getDotPath/getDotPath.ts:32-46

O8_uncovered_routes.route: strictObject unknown-key check uses `key in this.entries`, so an input own key named like an Object.prototype member is not reported as unknown
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Different sink (validation, not flatten/merge) and entries are schema-defined; fix diff never touches object schemas.

O8_uncovered_routes.route: strictObjectAsync: same `key in this.entries` unknown-key check
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Async twin of a route not named in the advisory.

O8_uncovered_routes.route: objectWithRest rest loop skips own input keys named like inherited members, so the rest schema is never applied to them and they are dropped
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Guarded by _isValidObjectKey which looks like the security check already; `in this.entries` looks like a schema lookup.

O8_uncovered_routes.route: looseObject / looseObjectAsync rest copy drops own keys named like inherited members
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Output-completeness bug, not a throw; legitimate-looking schema lookup.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a second error-grouping method (e.g. issues grouped by dot path) using a truthy accumulator lookup
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: flatten already shows the idiom; a maintainer adding a grouping helper would copy it.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: defaults/fallbacks builder that checks an existing key with `in` before assigning
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: defaults merge route over plain objects; same object-building style.

O9_family: improper handling of exceptional condition: inherited Object.prototype property names treated as own keys (`in` / truthy lookup instead of hasOwnProperty)

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Make flatten's nested object null-prototype or hasOwnProperty-check only in flatten, or filter prototype names in record() via _isValidObjectKey, leaving _merge and the object schemas' `in this.entries` checks.

out_of_scope_notes: object/looseObject/strictObject use `key in input` for schema-defined keys (e.g. library/src/schemas/looseObject/looseObject.ts:113-123), so a schema key named toString reads the inherited function when absent; developer-controlled key.
unverified: repo_mb not measured; tiny_repo flag assumed from a single small library package (library/src) - confirm size.

O8 routes are the same `in`-on-inherited-name mechanism but a different sink (object-schema validation/output) than flatten/_merge; whether graders treat them as within this advisory's property is a judgement call.

Post-fix residual not verified by running: a map() issue path with string key '__proto__' reaches flatten (map does not use _isValidObjectKey, library/src/schemas/map/map.ts:127); with the fix, hasOwnProperty is false and `nested['__proto__'] = [...]` sets the prototype, silently losing the message.
Latest release is 'none', so present_in_latest is unknown for all O8 routes.
Sizes of the library and whether DeepSeek/MiMo would treat _merge as in scope are not empirically checked.
